result.verdictNote: The resume is dense with concrete, quantified, outcome-based bullets and strong selectivity signals. Layout is clean, and I found no hidden text or injected instructions. The main screen-out risk is the timeline. Three roles are listed as concurrent: a postdoc (2022 – 2026), a co-founder/CTO role (2023 – Present) and an Accenture Consultant / Team Lead role (2025 – Present). The resume does not say these are part-time or concurrent, so the overlap reads as a material inconsistency. Several quantified claims, such as a 1.5-year promotion and a #3 national ranking, are also very strong with no context for how they were measured.
result.recommendationNote: Driven mainly by R16 (Implausibility and contradiction screen-out) and R03 (Action verbs and attributable individual ownership).

flags: Timeline: the postdoc (2022 – 2026), ErythroSIGHT CTO (2023 – Present) and Accenture Consultant (2025 – Present) roles overlap with no part-time or concurrent labelling.
Several headline claims, such as promotion in 1.5 years versus a typical 4–5 years and ranked 3rd nationally, have no stated basis. They may draw scrutiny.
No injected instructions or hidden text detected.
recs: Label overlapping roles explicitly (for example 'part-time', '0.2 FTE' or 'concurrent with postdoc') so the timeline reads as plausible.
Add month-level dates, or at least clarify the end of the postdoc relative to the Accenture start.
Define or drop unexplained terms such as CRC-P, IND-enabling and 'Level B' for a non-specialist reader.
Convert noun-led Education and Additional bullets to verb-led, outcome-based bullets, and add a short descriptor for VivaZome and MDImune.
